actual_scope: Independently check the early source observation of open PR #5827 on the pinned PR #5811 word: the seven-event role-695 interval at index 13815, the legal frames at that cut, and the paid ranks of frames 3, 597 and 1031.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one uncovered helper group and a complete invoice. This package does not search for a new split and does not replay the caller. It checks the first clause of the live #1166 handoff on PR #5827, whose smallest next task is an independent review of the early source observation, the direct native phase and the full bill. Only the early observation and its frame ranks are settled here.
bottleneck_link: Complex currently binds. PR #5827 claims a small conditional gain by replacing two role-695 transports with one direct transport. The early read is the identity that makes those transports equivalent on arbitrary entry values. Correcting which leg has rank 4 tells a later native-phase audit which maps to inspect. This package does not raise selected kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the unique seven-event identity, the frame-rank correction and the early-read controls. Do not rerun the sealed caller, Clifford lowering or outer moment.
evidence: research/p104-unread-early-read/verify.py prints PASS_P104_UNREAD_EARLY_READ. It replays the vendored PR5811 and PR5827 words, checks the four-role images and rejects the proof sentence that frames 3, 597 and 1031 have dimensions 0, 4 and 5.
